```{r packages}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(glmnet)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
```

```{r data-and-train, include=FALSE}
# ----------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------
data("Boston", package = "MASS")
boston.df <- Boston

# ----------------------------
# Split
# ----------------------------
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(boston.df$medv, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train <- boston.df[idx, ]
test  <- boston.df[-idx, ]

x_train_raw <- train %>% select(-medv)
x_test_raw  <- test  %>% select(-medv)
y_train <- train$medv
y_test  <- test$medv

# ----------------------------
# Preprocess (for glmnet)
# ----------------------------
preproc <- preProcess(x_train_raw, method = c("center", "scale"))
x_train <- predict(preproc, x_train_raw)
x_test  <- predict(preproc, x_test_raw)

# ----------------------------
# CV control + metrics
# ----------------------------
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 10, repeats = 3)

rmse <- function(actual, pred) sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae  <- function(actual, pred) mean(abs(actual - pred), na.rm = TRUE)
r2   <- function(actual, pred) {
  # Guard: constant predictions -> cor() returns NA (sd = 0)
  if (sd(pred, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cor(actual, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2
}

# ----------------------------
# Train models
# ----------------------------
# Baseline: mean predictor
baseline_pred <- rep(mean(y_train), length(y_test))

# Linear Regression
set.seed(123)
lm_fit <- train(medv ~ ., data = train, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl)
lm_pred <- predict(lm_fit, newdata = test)

# Elastic Net (glmnet)
grid_glmnet <- expand.grid(
  alpha  = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
  lambda = 10^seq(-3, 1, length.out = 40)
)
set.seed(123)
glmnet_fit <- train(
  x = as.matrix(x_train),
  y = y_train,
  method = "glmnet",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = grid_glmnet
)
glmnet_pred <- predict(glmnet_fit, newdata = as.matrix(x_test))

# Random Forest (best in report)
set.seed(42)
rf_fit <- train(
  medv ~ ., data = train,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneLength = 8
)
rf_pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test)

# ----------------------------
# Model comparison table (test set)
# ----------------------------
results <- tibble(
  Model = c("Random Forest", "Elastic Net (glmnet)", "Linear Regression", "Baseline (Train Mean)"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse(y_test, rf_pred), rmse(y_test, glmnet_pred), rmse(y_test, lm_pred), rmse(y_test, baseline_pred)),
  MAE   = c(mae(y_test, rf_pred),  mae(y_test, glmnet_pred),  mae(y_test, lm_pred),  mae(y_test, baseline_pred)),
  R2    = c(r2(y_test, rf_pred),   r2(y_test, glmnet_pred),   r2(y_test, lm_pred),   r2(y_test, baseline_pred))
) %>% arrange(RMSE)

best_model_name <- results$Model[1]

# ----------------------------
# Deployment scoring function (from analysis)
# ----------------------------
score_medv <- function(newdata, best_model_name = best_model_name) {
  # Ensure columns match training structure
  required_cols <- names(train %>% select(-medv))
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(newdata))) {
    stop("newdata must include all predictor columns used in training.")
  }
  newdata <- newdata %>% select(all_of(required_cols))

  pred <- switch(
    best_model_name,
    "Linear Regression"        = predict(lm_fit, newdata = newdata),
    "Elastic Net (glmnet)"     = {
      x_new <- predict(preproc, newdata)
      predict(glmnet_fit, newdata = as.matrix(x_new))
    },
    "Random Forest"            = predict(rf_fit, newdata = newdata),
    "Baseline (Train Mean)"    = rep(mean(y_train), nrow(newdata)),
    # default (safety)
    rep(mean(y_train), nrow(newdata))
  )

  as.numeric(pred)
}

# ----------------------------
# Feature importance (RF)
# ----------------------------
rf_final <- rf_fit$finalModel
imp <- randomForest::importance(rf_final)
imp_df <- tibble(
  Feature = rownames(imp),
  Importance = imp[, 1]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

# ----------------------------
# Test-set plotting frames
# ----------------------------
preds_test <- tibble(
  actual = y_test,
  `Random Forest`        = as.numeric(rf_pred),
  `Elastic Net (glmnet)` = as.numeric(glmnet_pred),
  `Linear Regression`    = as.numeric(lm_pred),
  `Baseline (Train Mean)`= as.numeric(baseline_pred)
)

default_ranges <- map_dfr(names(train %>% select(-medv)), ~{
  tibble(
    feature = .x,
    min = min(train[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(train[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(train[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})
```

Inputs (Sidebar)
=====================================

```{r}
# Sidebar controls
selectInput(
  "model_choice",
  "Choose model for scoring",
  choices = results$Model,
  selected = best_model_name
)

hr()

h4("Manual Inputs (single prediction)")
helpText("Defaults are set to training medians. Adjust and click Predict.")

# Make numeric inputs dynamically for all predictors
uiOutput("manual_inputs")

actionButton("btn_predict", "Predict medv", class = "btn-primary")
br(); br()
verbatimTextOutput("pred_value")

hr()

h4("Batch Scoring (upload CSV)")
helpText("Upload a CSV with all 13 predictor columns. You'll get predictions back (downloadable).")

fileInput("csv_file", "Upload CSV", accept = c(".csv"))
actionButton("btn_score_csv", "Score CSV", class = "btn-success")
br(); br()
downloadButton("download_scored", "Download Scored CSV")
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  m <- input$model_choice

  df <- tibble(
    actual = preds_test$actual,
    predicted = preds_test[[m]]
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Actual vs Predicted —", m),
      x = "Actual medv ($1000s)",
      y = "Predicted medv ($1000s)"
    )

  ggplotly(p)
})
```

### Error Distribution (Actual - Predicted)

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  m <- input$model_choice
  df <- tibble(error = preds_test$actual - preds_test[[m]])

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = error)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Prediction Error Distribution —", m),
      x = "Actual - Predicted ($1000s)",
      y = "Count"
    )

  ggplotly(p)
})
```

```{r server, include=FALSE}
# ----------------------------
# Server logic
# ----------------------------

# Dynamic manual input UI (one numericInput per predictor)
output$manual_inputs <- renderUI({
  req(default_ranges)

  controls <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(default_ranges)), function(i) {
    f <- default_ranges$feature[i]
    mn <- default_ranges$min[i]
    mx <- default_ranges$max[i]
    md <- default_ranges$median[i]

    numericInput(
      inputId = paste0("x_", f),
      label   = f,
      value   = md,
      min     = mn,
      max     = mx,
      step    = (mx - mn) / 100
    )
  })

  # Layout: two columns for readability
  fluidRow(
    column(6, controls[seq(1, length(controls), by = 2)]),
    column(6, controls[seq(2, length(controls), by = 2)])
  )
})

# Manual single prediction
observeEvent(input$btn_predict, {
  req(input$model_choice)

  required_cols <- names(train %>% select(-medv))

  new_row <- map_dfc(required_cols, function(f) {
    tibble(!!f := input[[paste0("x_", f)]])
  })

  pred <- score_medv(new_row, best_model_name = input$model_choice)

  output$pred_value <- renderText({
    paste0(
      "Predicted medv (", input$model_choice, "): ",
      round(pred, 2),
      " ($1000s)"
    )
  })
})

# Batch scoring CSV
scored_reactive <- reactiveVal(NULL)

observeEvent(input$btn_score_csv, {
  req(input$csv_file, input$model_choice)

  df <- readr::read_csv(input$csv_file$datapath, show_col_types = FALSE)

  required_cols <- names(train %>% select(-medv))
  missing <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    showNotification(
      paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ", ")),
      type = "error",
      duration = 8
    )
    return(NULL)
  }

  preds <- score_medv(df, best_model_name = input$model_choice)
  scored <- df %>%
    select(all_of(required_cols)) %>%
    mutate(pred_medv = preds)

  scored_reactive(scored)

  showNotification("CSV scored successfully. Preview below and download when ready.", type = "message")
})

output$download_scored <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0("boston_scored_", gsub("\\W+", "_", input$model_choice), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) {
    req(scored_reactive())
    readr::write_csv(scored_reactive(), file)
  }
)
```
